> 第7章 胖子死于非命（第1页）
“乳臭未干的毛孩子也敢老气横秋的教导我们如何做人？”青衣队长老神在在地看着郑风，不由大笑三声。
“兄弟们，面对如此无视我们兄弟的毛孩儿，我们该怎么做？”青衣一脸讥笑。
“逮过来脱了裤子，每人狠揍一顿，大伙先教他如何做人！”
”我们的善良就是让他多活半个时辰。“
一众骑手此时来了兴致，觉得不能轻易放过这个狂妄自大的毛孩子。众人先找找乐子，乐呵乐呵！
“我想知道你们为何对我紧追不舍，我们素昧平生，自认也未对你等做过伤天害理的事情？”郑风一脸无辜，也十分好奇地看着一众骑手。
“真想知道？”青衣头领故意大声问道。
“磕几个响头，再叫三声爷爷，我就告诉你！”一骑手肆意大笑。
“你说叫什么？刚才风大没有听清楚。”郑风无语，故意掏了掏耳朵。
“你们太客气了，喊我回去喝酒还是吃肉啊？难得你们一片孝心！”郑风笑呵呵地，尽力做出满脸慈祥，奈何光洁的俊脸真不具备表现慈祥的条件，滑稽的表情令一众骑手恼羞成怒。
“喊你去吃屎喝尿！”一胖子骑手大喝，有几分抓狂。
“不肖子孙，还要如此虐待你爷爷，真不该让你爹造出你这个混蛋玩意，丢人现眼。”郑风一脸悔恨的表情，可是惟妙惟肖。
“你去死吧！”胖子骑手气得七窍生烟，满脸涨红，羞得无地自容。
胖子催动马匹，一杆长枪猛刺过来，眨眼就到了郑风身前。
“不好了，不孝孙子打爷爷啦！真是家门不幸！”郑风边喊边跑，胖子紧追不舍，郑风跑的来时的方向，一众骑手见郑风并未打算逃跑，也不着急，乐意看着胖子脸红脖子粗的策马追着郑风跑，也倒是有趣。
“小子欠打，看你能跑出我的手心。”胖子一杆长枪竖着刺、横着扫。左冲右突，忙得不可开交，郑风不急不缓，游刃有余的游走，让胖子总是感觉就差那么一点点。
胖子一副不抓到郑风不罢休的架势引得一众骑手喝彩助兴，也想看看郑风到底能躲多久。
一炷香过去了，胖子追得上火，脸上汗水滴答，全身汗流浃背，骏马都被他双腿夹得不断地嘶鸣，本想玩猫捉老鼠的游戏，然而被戏耍得不轻。

胖子没脸见人，喘着粗气，退到了一边。
看到胖子求助得眼神，青衣领队的脸阴沉了下来。
“玩得差不多了，你们几个一起上，抓住他，直接拧下头颅，回去领赏。”青衣领头的发话了。
“你真是这么想的？”郑风眯着眼，冷眼看着青衣领队。
“呵呵，不用废话，一起出手。”青衣领队吩咐下，几位骑手，几杆长枪，齐齐出手，一道道枪芒激射而来。
“既然你们不懂得做人要善良，那你们就回炉去造造，家门不幸，一群不孝子孙！”郑风老神在在一副痛心疾首的表情。
待众骑手反应过来，看到几闪几晃就站到一旁的郑风，不由怒从心头起，恶从胆边生，齐齐催马出枪。喘着大气，力道之猛，尽了全力，动了真怒。
道道枪芒激射一处，枪芒过后，几位骑手发现，枪尖所过之处，一个白花花的躯体上破了个大洞。
原来白白胖胖的胖子身上被众人长枪同时刺到一处，对穿对过，从这边透过胖子的身体正好看到对面郑风嘲笑的脸。
胖子早就没有了气息，胖子所骑的骏马还停留在原地。

> Chapter 7 The fat man died unexpectedly (Page 1)
"How dare a young boy teach us how to be a human being in such an old-fashioned way?" The old man in the Qingyi team looked at Zheng Feng and couldn't help but laugh three times.
"Brothers, what should we do when faced with such a stupid kid who ignores our brothers?" Qing Yi sneered.
"Catch him, take off his pants, and give each of them a good beating. Let's teach him how to behave first!"
"Our kindness is to let him live for half an hour longer."
All the riders became interested at this time and felt that they could not let this arrogant kid off easily. Everyone is looking for fun first, have fun!
"I want to know why you are chasing after me. We are strangers, and I don't think I have done anything harmful to you and others?" Zheng Feng looked innocent and looked at the riders with great curiosity.
"Really want to know?" The leader in Qingyi asked loudly and deliberately.
"Kowtow a few times, call me grandpa three more times, and I'll tell you!" A rider laughed wantonly.
"What did you say it was called? Feng Da didn't hear it clearly just now." Zheng Feng was speechless and deliberately picked his ears.
"You are too polite. Are you asking me to go back to drink or eat meat? It's rare for you to show filial piety!" Zheng Feng laughed and tried his best to make his face full of kindness. However, his smooth and handsome face really did not have the conditions to show kindness. His funny expression made all the riders angry.
"I told you to eat shit and drink urine!" a fat rider shouted, a little crazy.
"You are an unworthy descendant, and you still abuse your grandfather like this. You really shouldn't let your father create such a bastard thing like you and be so embarrassed." Zheng Feng's expression of remorse was lifelike.
"Go to hell!" The fat rider was so angry that his face was red and he was ashamed.
The fat man spurred the horse, thrust a spear at him, and arrived in front of Zheng Feng in the blink of an eye.
"No, the unfilial grandson is beating up grandpa! What a misfortune for the family!" Zheng Feng shouted and ran, with the fat man chasing after him. In the direction in which Zheng Feng came, the riders saw that Zheng Feng had no intention of running away, so they were not in a hurry. They were happy to watch the fat man chase Zheng Feng with a red face and thick neck. It was quite interesting.
"You need a beating, let's see if you can escape from my grasp." The fat man stabbed vertically and swept horizontally with his spear. Rushing left and right, he was very busy, Zheng Feng was not in a hurry, and moved with ease, making the fat man always feel that he was just a little bit behind.
The fat man's attitude of not giving up until he caught Zheng Feng attracted a group of riders to cheer and cheer, and they also wanted to see how long Zheng Feng could hide.
A stick of incense passed, and the fat man caught fire. His face was dripping with sweat, and his whole body was covered with sweat. The horse was pinched between his legs and kept neighing. He wanted to play a game of cat and mouse, but he was played badly.
The fat man was too embarrassed to see anyone. He gasped and stepped aside.
Seeing the fat man's pleading look, the leader in green's face darkened.
"It's almost time to play. You guys come together, catch him, twist off his head, and go back to collect the reward." The leader in Qingyi spoke.
"Do you really think so?" Zheng Feng squinted and looked at the leader in green with cold eyes.
"Haha, no need to talk nonsense, let's take action together." Under the command of the leader in green, several riders and several spears all took action together, and a stream of gun light came out.
"Since you don't know how to be kind, then you go back to the furnace and create a group of unfilial descendants!" Old God Zheng Feng looked distressed.
When all the riders came to their senses and saw Zheng Feng standing aside after a few flashes, they couldn't help but feel angry in their hearts and fearful, and they all urged their horses to draw their guns. He gasped for air, exerted great strength, tried his best, and was really angry.
The gun light shot out in one place. After the gun light passed, several riders discovered that where the spear tip passed, a big hole was broken in a white body.
It turns out that it’s all white and fat on the fat man’s bodyThey were stabbed in one place by everyone's spears at the same time, passing through each other. From here through the fat man's body, he could see Zheng Feng's mocking face on the opposite side.
The fat man had lost his breath a long time ago, and the horse he was riding was still in the same place.
